incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PAGER FIRED for service=embeddings-eu-west | metric=p99_latency | value=2.10s | threshold=1.50s | pd=INC12345
mike_oncall: acked, I'm on it
sara_sre: on it, pulling dashboards — @mike_oncall what region?
mike_oncall: eu-west, embeddings read path. load spike ~20% on pods
jordan_eng: saw similar noise earlier; could be kv-cache warmups after rollout?
sara_sre: graphs: `kpod-emb-*` CPU normal, but `embed-sidecar` p95/p99 spike. link: https://dash.redwood/embeds?from=now-15m
lee_support: any customer-facing errors? support shows a few 502s on chat integrations
mike_oncall: no ERROR budget breach yet, but latency spike is affecting realtime sampling
sara_sre: running quick check: `kubectl top pods -n embeds | grep embed-sidecar` shows mem stable
jordan_eng: try fallback to emb-small variant via router policy — compatible for TTL < 4k tokens
mike_oncall: initiating model fallback: `curl -XPOST https://infra/route/swap -d '{"service":"embeds","variant":"emb-small"}'`
incident-bot: deploybot: route change started by mike_oncall — job: 8234
deploybot: route swap completed in 12s — new route: emb-small (canary 100%)
sara_sre: rolling fallback applied. monitoring
mike_oncall: traffic shifted. p99 dropping to ~0.9s
lee_support: posting update to customers in #support-status: "Experiencing elevated latency for semantic search in EU, mitigation applied"
jordan_eng: still seeing occasional 1.6s spikes correlated with `kv-cache-miss` logs. maybe prefix cache cold
sara_sre: warming cache: ```for key in $(cat hotkeys.txt); do curl https://embeds/lookup?key=$key & done``` — running
mike_oncall: autoscaler shows surge but AZ quota at 80% — will open quick request to infra to allow burst
mike_oncall: @infra_oncall can you lift GPU pod quota temporarily? (ping)
infra_oncall: I'll approve a 2-node burst for 20m, doing now
infra_oncall: quota increase applied
sara_sre: new pods spun up, backend throughput increased
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 acknowledged by mike_oncall
lee_support: support note: some enterprise customers saw degraded search scores; filed ticket INC-922
mike_oncall: recommend keeping emb-small until morning. plan: revert once kv-cache warmed and autoscaler stabilized
jordan_eng: follow-up: opening PR to add proactive kv warm on deploys -> repo/embeds PR #412
mike_oncall: added follow-up action to incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/1855555555
sara_sre: current p99 = 0.75s, p95 = 0.18s. closing loop
mike_oncall: thanks everyone. will hand off to morning rotation at 08:00 UTC. @next_oncall please take note
lee_support: leaving a short customer-facing summary in the ticket. :thumbsup:
mike_oncall: closing pager now. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 resolved by mike_oncall
